slides.title: Relationship *myths*, busted
slides.sub: Things everyone says that aren’t actually true.

slides.truth: How you repair matters more than how often you argue.
Nobody reads minds. Say what you need, kindly and clearly.
Sparks need fuel: new things, tried together.
Different hobbies keep you both interesting.
Time apart makes time together better.
Boring is often just another word for comfortable.

slides.title: Save this *and send it to the overthinker.*
slides.sub: Which myth did you believe the longest?
